Democrats win a majority in the US House and Senate elections, [[18]](https://www.foxnews.com/media/conservatives-stunned-catastrophic-midterm-blue-tsunami-blame-trumps-iran-war-high-gas-prices)[[19]](https://www.foxnews.com/politics/dems-seize-senate-blue-tidal-wave-crashes-deep-trump-country-topples-gop-strongholds) with Abdul El-Sayed winning in Michigan and gaining access to classified materials.
